# meta-hypertools

> Manage MCP server fleets from one process: runtime control, diagnostics, GitHub repo inspiration, and automated cold-start / cold-install health probes. Transports: **stdio MCP** (IDEs) and **HTTP** (FastAPI + React dashboard `web_sota`). Local operator tool -- see [docs/PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md).

**Full detail: see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)**

---

## Ports

| Service | Default |
|---------|---------|
| Web + API (production static) | `10718` |
| Vite dev frontend | `10719` |
| Fleet Starts launcher (optional) | `10796` |

Bind via `HOST` / `PORT` in `.env`.

---

## Run (summary)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/meta-hypertools.git
cd meta-mcp
uv sync --group dev
copy .env.example .env   # set REPOS_DIR, WURST_AUTH_TOKEN
uv run meta-mcp          # dashboard http://127.0.0.1:10718
uv run meta-mcp-server   # stdio MCP for IDE
```

Regenerate tool list: `uv run python scripts/dump_mcp_tools.py`

---

## REST API (2026-09 additions)

Chat (agentic loop with confirm gate for mutating calls):

- `GET /api/v1/chat/context` -- personalities + compact tool catalog
- `POST /api/v1/chat/agent` -- system preprompt + bounded tool loop, trace
- `POST /api/v1/chat/agent/confirm` -- approve/deny paused mutating calls

Repo discovery (GitHub search proxy, token stays server-side):

- `GET /api/v1/inspire/presets` -- 8 curated searches
- `GET /api/v1/inspire/search?q=&language=&topic=&min_stars=&sort=` -- repos
  with stars/forks/issues/cadence/rocket/archived/license/topics markers

Docs and standards:

- `GET /api/v1/standards` / `GET /api/v1/standards/{path}` -- handbook browser
- `GET /api/v1/session-docs` (+ `source`/`prune_allowed`) and
  `DELETE /api/v1/session-docs?before=YYYY-MM-DD` (private archives only;
  403 on the shared handbook log)

---

## Tools (summary)

Discovery: `help`, `show_mcp_overview`, `find_mcp_tools`, `inspire_repo_help`

| Suite | Examples |
|-------|----------|
| Dynamic routing | `meta_route_tool`, `meta_search_capabilities`, `meta_routing_status` |
| Fleet runtime | `get_fleet_status`, `launch_fleet_app`, `stop_fleet_app` |
| Fleet probes | `fleet_startup_probe`, `fleet_cold_install_probe`, `*_report` |
| Diagnostics | `scan_mcp_unicode`, `validate_mcp_pwsh`, `audit_mcp_implementation` |
| Analysis | `analyze_mcp_runts`, `show_mcp_status`, `list_analysis_depot` |
| Repo inspiration | `inspire_repo`, `inspire_repo_workflow`, `inspire_repo_structure_card` |
| Server mgmt | `start_mcp_server`, `stop_mcp_server`, `discover_mcp_servers` |
| Client / toolchains | `read_client_config`, `apply_mcp_toolchain` |
| Meta dev | `probe_fleet_health`, `diff_mcp_configs`, `audit_secret_redaction` |

Full tool table: [llms-full.txt#tools](llms-full.txt)
